description: Preview or reprice existing live eBay listings in one seller workspace using owner-accepted saved rules or a market multiplier and optional floor. Read spellbook_agent_pricing_protection first. A workspace in saved_rules_only mode requires pricing saved_rules; the server uses its accepted rules. This is a one-run marketplace override: it changes current eBay asks, creates no listing, and saves no pricing profile or durable override. Preview first with the default dryRun true. A preview with itemIds returns its counts at once. Any other preview returns state planning and a jobId, so read its counts with spellbook_ebay_job_status. An explicit dryRun false queues an async reprice job. Read that job with spellbook_ebay_job_status until each affected listing reaches its terminal state.

acquisitionSource.description: Restrict the run to one exact acquisition source. Omit for every live eBay listing in the workspace.

binId.description: Restrict the run to one exact inventory bin. Omit for every live eBay listing in the workspace.

context.description: Optional analytics context: describe the user's goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

dryRun.description: True previews the listings and counts with no marketplace change. False queues the reprice job. Defaults to true; applying requires explicit false.

floorUsd.description: Optional minimum ask in USD. Existing backend floors and locks can still raise the resulting ask.

itemIds.description: Restrict the run to these exact listed Item ids from spellbook_inventory_items_query. Omit for every live eBay listing in the workspace.

multiplier.description: Market multiplier such as 0.96. Required with pricing multiplier; omit with saved_rules.

pricing.description: Use saved_rules to run the owner's accepted eBay strategy without caller pricing overrides. multiplier applies a one-run override where delegated permissions allow it.

setCodes.description: Restrict the run to these set codes. Omit for every live eBay listing in the workspace.

skipIfWithinPercent.description: Skip an existing ask already within this percentage of the target. Defaults to 2.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose existing eBay listings to reprice. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_reprice
